purpose: Teach: 拳銃/失踪/濃縮/閉じ込め/荒廃/痴呆/損なわ/マルクス主義

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、警備員の拳銃所持は法令を守れ
lines.en: Our company will comply with the law regarding armed security personnel.
lines.style: Measured and direct. Slight emphasis on 「law」 — not a suggestion, a boundary. Composed authority. Shoulders set. Clear eye contact.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員の失踪事案にはすぐに対応します
lines.en: Yes. We'll respond immediately to any incidents involving missing staff members.
lines.style: Attentive and ready. Acknowledging tone. Professional nod in the voice. Steady rhythm — no hesitation. Shows he's already thinking through procedures.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、新製品にエキスを濃縮する技術を活かせ
lines.en: Our company should also leverage our extraction and concentration technology for new products.
lines.style: Considered, building on the previous point. Light forward momentum. Slight pause before 「leverage」 — he's thinking of next steps. Measured but engaged.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。情報を社内に閉じ込めない透明性を保ちます
lines.en: Understood. We'll maintain transparency by keeping information accessible across departments, not locked away.
lines.style: Calm confirmation with substance. Not just agreeing — demonstrating he's absorbed the instruction. Steady pace. Professional but not stiff.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、市場の荒廃を防ぐ社会貢献も検討しろ
lines.en: Our company should also consider our social responsibility in preventing market deterioration.
lines.style: Directing toward values beyond profit. Slightly broader tone — more philosophical than the previous technical directives. Still composed. A moment of weight before continuing.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。痴呆症の家族を持つ社員を支援します
lines.en: Yes. We can support employees with family members affected by cognitive decline.
lines.style: Specific commitment. Warm undertone beneath professionalism. Shows he understands this matters beyond metrics. Careful precision in delivery — this is human, not operational.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、ブランドを損なわぬ広告を作れ
lines.en: Our company needs advertising that protects our brand integrity.
lines.style: Clear and non-negotiable. Firm on 「integrity」. Not harsh — just precise. The tone of someone who knows brand damage is preventable with discipline.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。マルクス主義系の経営思想にも触れて学習します
lines.en: Understood. I'll ensure our learning includes engagement with various management philosophies, including Marxist thought.
lines.style: Closing commitment with intellectual seriousness. Slight widening of perspective in the voice — showing intellectual openness. Ends with quiet confidence. Not defensive about the breadth of study.
